Sorry about the delay, Ana. Unfortunately, delays caused by severe weather such as a snowstorm are not eligible for credit, so I can't offer a credit for this delay.

If the delay had a different cause, a late Standard parcel (arriving after the last day of its promised window) gets a 25% credit of the shipping fee. The credit goes to your account within 7 days and can't be paid out in cash.

If you send me the tracking number of the parcel (for example NW1002), I can check whether it qualifies.
